props.text: What happened: Zenith Protocol moved 41% this week after ZIP-14 passed, authorizing a protocol-funded treasury buyback — the single largest driver at 18 points. Volume expansion and new staking inflows added another 19 points combined, with the broader crypto market contributing a modest 4. Why it matters: this is a real, on-chain governance catalyst on elevated volume, not an unexplained spike or a rising-tide move — the buyback mechanically shrinks circulating supply against a capped 100M max, a structural effect that outlasts the headline. Next step: watch buyback execution volume over the coming weeks to confirm the supply-side effect is actually landing, not just announced.
